info.name: Aruba Central Access Points Sites API

description.content:
RESTful API for managing the HPE Aruba Networking Central cloud platform. Provides unified network management, AI-based analytics, device monitoring, and configuration for wired, wireless, and SD-WAN networks. Aruba Central serves as a single pane of glass for managing access points, switches, gateways, and SD-WAN appliances across distributed enterprise environments.
